tests.label: Registry exposes six distinct real sources and seven production stages
Entering measured spine work returns knowledge without falsely approving the fish
Documented source intake alias selects identity rather than failing or skipping its gate
Unknown gill motion remains a local HOLD despite measured eyes and spine
A new fish starts without inherited evidence or numerical calibration
Read-only entry creates no files; explicit output preserves existing user files
Invalid requests, unknown stages, malformed cards and ambiguous modes fail closed
All production source cards validate without changing their measurements or readiness
Stale knowledge, unreferenced source measurements and unsupported species confirmation fail validation
Engineering guesses or absent backbone cannot stand in for measured source structure
Knowledge formulas and regression records still point to real production files
Numeric behavior parameters reject missing or dimensionally wrong units
CLI actually detects stale source evidence and refuses outside-repository bindings

scope: Producer knowledge and CLI checks; no visual, biological or independent approval
